# Guided walkthrough — 30 illustrated lessons

Artificial demonstration data; not laboratory results. Research use only. MISSY is not validated.

Captured from the public **2026.10.31.demolabels1** page on 1 November 2026. All 30 lesson descriptions are taken from the running demo. Screenshots show the webpage, not PDF reports.

## 1. Meet Dr Lin

Dr Lin has 32 runs to review. Six have a signal shift. Help identify the affected evidence and prepare a traceable review report — without editing original values.

![Walkthrough lesson 1: Meet Dr Lin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-01.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 1: Meet Dr Lin*

## 2. Stage the embedded file

Start with one embedded, explicitly artificial RDML file. No laboratory files or internet are needed.

![Walkthrough lesson 2: Stage the embedded file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-02.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 2: Stage the embedded file*

## 3. Read the evidence

Watch the real intake read 32 artificial runs and 768 target records. Cq values, amplification curves and melting arrays stay linked.

![Walkthrough lesson 3: Read the evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-03.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 3: Read the evidence*

## 4. Narrow the sample scope

Dr Lin filters sample names before interpretation. Filtering is a view/selection step; it does not rewrite measurements.

![Walkthrough lesson 4: Narrow the sample scope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-04.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 4: Narrow the sample scope*

## 5. Create a review-only SOP

A named SOP makes rules and report identity traceable. This fictional profile is not a validated method.

![Walkthrough lesson 5: Create a review-only SOP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-05.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 5: Create a review-only SOP*

## 6. Specify targets and controls

Make thresholds and controls explicit. Absolute, relative and melting configuration fields are also available; a template alone is not a validated calculation method.

![Walkthrough lesson 6: Specify targets and controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-06.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 6: Specify targets and controls*

## 7. Read the sample outcome

Inspect one run first. Cq, replicate counts, outcome and reason remain visible together. All values here are artificial.

![Walkthrough lesson 7: Read the sample outcome](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-07.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 7: Read the sample outcome*

## 8. Find one run and sample

Use the experiment selector and text search together. Dr Lin isolates DEMO_SAMPLE_0 instead of reading hundreds of rows.

![Walkthrough lesson 8: Find one run and sample](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-08.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 8: Find one run and sample*

## 9. See the history at a glance

The Control panel separates hardware, software, method and operator signals. Thirty-two compatible artificial runs support a baseline.

![Walkthrough lesson 9: See the history at a glance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-09.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 9: See the history at a glance*

## 10. Know the hardware reference

QuantStudio 5 specifications are manufacturer reference values for the stated block variant. Simulator measurements are labelled separately.

![Walkthrough lesson 10: Know the hardware reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-10.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 10: Know the hardware reference*

## 11. Check heating stability

Chapter 2: investigate the shift. The dark chart makes the stable artificial heating history easy to see.

![Walkthrough lesson 11: Check heating stability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-11.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 11: Check heating stability*

## 12. Check cooling independently

Cooling can change independently of heating. This light-background example shows the same chart controls and readable limits.

![Walkthrough lesson 12: Check cooling independently](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-12.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 12: Check cooling independently*

## 13. Locate the six drifting runs

The last six runs show a deliberately increasing background. Look at the highlighted red points, not the entire page.

![Walkthrough lesson 13: Locate the six drifting runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-13.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 13: Locate the six drifting runs*

The tour presses the real Red alert for this artificial scenario. This scripted click does not add an automatic production alarm rule.

![Walkthrough lesson 14: Call attention to the drift](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-14.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 14: Call attention to the drift*

*Walkthrough lesson 15: Stop, then try voice Next*

## 16. Open the voice menu

![Walkthrough lesson 16: Open the voice menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-16.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 16: Open the voice menu*

## 17. Zoom using two choices

![Walkthrough lesson 17: Zoom using two choices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-17.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 17: Zoom using two choices*

## 18. Inspect amplification

Compare the artificial sigmoid rises and the flat NTC. Stored Cq and traces stay linked to their sample and channel.

![Walkthrough lesson 18: Inspect amplification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-18.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 18: Inspect amplification*

## 19. Read a calibration limitation

A high R² is not enough. This light-background standard curve spans only two log units, below the illustrative profile requirement.

![Walkthrough lesson 19: Read a calibration limitation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-19.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 19: Read a calibration limitation*

## 20. Compare melting evidence

Two artificial products have supplied Tm values near 78 and 82 °C. The dark preview shows the retained fluorescence arrays.

![Walkthrough lesson 20: Compare melting evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-20.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 20: Compare melting evidence*

## 21. Verify the plate layout

Chapter 3: prepare traceable evidence. Check positions, roles and channels before selecting report figures.

![Walkthrough lesson 21: Verify the plate layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-21.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 21: Verify the plate layout*

## 22. Compare samples

Dr Lin compares compatible samples and replicates rather than mixing targets or protocols.

![Walkthrough lesson 22: Compare samples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-22.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 22: Compare samples*

## 23. Check grouped statistics

Review counts and grouped variability. A single grand Cq mean across different targets is not an assay conclusion.

![Walkthrough lesson 23: Check grouped statistics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-23.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 23: Check grouped statistics*

## 24. Trace the source evidence

Instrument records and file integrity explain where values came from. A checksum identifies bytes; it does not certify an experiment.

![Walkthrough lesson 24: Trace the source evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-24.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 24: Trace the source evidence*

## 25. Choose an open output

Exports preserve evidence and scope. The demo does not silently download files or send data to a server.

![Walkthrough lesson 25: Choose an open output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-25.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 25: Choose an open output*

## 26. Make shortcuts useful

The 12 animals can open pages or specific charts. Dr Lin can bind a shortcut to the drift chart without changing real saved assignments.

![Walkthrough lesson 26: Make shortcuts useful](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-26.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 26: Make shortcuts useful*

## 27. Keep commands and details together

Commands groups modes, status report, Details and GPL/source. The tour shows diagnostics without downloading a file.

![Walkthrough lesson 27: Keep commands and details together](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mihaiionitabio-alt/zpcrweb/missy-public-offline-2026-10-20/documentation/releases/2026-11-01-illustrated-wiki/images/current-guided-27.jpg)

*Walkthrough lesson 27: Keep commands and details together*
